blocking_issues.detail: Recurring continuation schedule creation was rejected because the current project is not deployed. Continue current-session production; re-attempt only after the user completes the managed publish flow.

Fresh AI video generation was limited at 1/1 and fresh AI image generation was limited at 20/20. Reel 0003 retained its failure/recovery event and used only documented existing approved visual assets. Future reels requiring fresh visuals must wait for quota reset or use an explicitly recorded non-fresh fallback.

notes: A reel is complete only after source metadata, QC evidence, and a verified Google Drive upload are recorded. The daily schedule is deferred until the project is deployed through the managed publish flow.
